subject: SolaceOps: Onramp checklist for AWS Marketplace PO (GovCloud scope)
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Carter <emily@solaceops.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: SolaceOps: Onramp checklist for AWS Marketplace PO (GovCloud scope)

Hi Emily —

Great to meet you last week. Per our intake call, here’s a compact onramp checklist to get SolaceOps live on AWS Marketplace with the Reserved Offer and GovCloud scope. I’ve kept the asks minimal so your procurement team can action items quickly.

Immediate items we need from you (target: 10 business days):
- Signed PO (PDF) referencing deal DL-2025-0821 and Redwood Inference SOW v1.2 — please send to procurements@redwoodinference.com.
- W9 (or tax doc for your org) — attach to reply.
- Marketplace registration confirmation (console screenshot or Partner Central ticket).
- Indicate whether you require Redwood to use your KMS key when processing customer data in GovCloud (yes/no).

Internal next steps on our side: Vanessa will validate PO fields and route to finance; Kimberly will prep activation packet and the vendor evidence binder.

Attachments I’ve included for your convenience: PO template (fillable), activation checklist, and sample vendor evidence list.

If you want, we can run a 20-minute PO walkthrough with your procurement contact this week — tell me what times work.

Thanks,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0182

Attachments: PO_Template_Redwood.docx (fillable), Marketplace_Onramp_Checklist.pdf (overview)

From: Emily Carter <emily@solaceops.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurements@solaceops.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SolaceOps: Onramp checklist for AWS Marketplace PO (GovCloud scope)

Thanks, Sean — this is helpful. A couple quick clarifications from our procurement team:

1) PO fields: we need the Redwood legal entity + address to match your invoice terms. Can you confirm the exact payee name and remit address?
2) GovCloud KMS: We require customer-managed KMS for the GovCloud deployment. Can you confirm Redwood supports bringing our key (we’ll provide the ARN)?
3) Contract term: our standard procurement team wants a 12-month minimum term instead of the 6-month term in SOW v1.2 — is that something we can align on?

We’ve attached our standard PO header (procurements@solaceops.com) and a W9. I’ll loop in our AWS listing contact separately to coordinate marketplace activation steps.

Best,
Emily Carter
Head of Procurement, SolaceOps
emily@solaceops.com

Attachments: SolaceOps_PO_Header.pdf, SolaceOps_W9.pdf

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Carter <emily@solaceops.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, AWS Marketplace Partner <aws-mp-partner@amazon.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SolaceOps: Onramp checklist for AWS Marketplace PO (GovCloud scope)

Emily — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. Responses inline below: 

1) Payee and remit address: Redwood Inference, Inc.
   220 3rd St, Suite 200
   San Francisco, CA 94103
   EIN: 81-2345678
(Will confirm the exact invoice header but this is the legal payee to reference on the PO.)

2) KMS in GovCloud: we support customer-managed KMS keys in GovCloud. Kimberly, can you confirm the activation checklist step for a customer-supplied key?

3) Contract term: looping in Lauren (legal ops lead) — Lauren, subject to a short redline to SOW v1.2 we can accept a 12-month term for the Reserved Offer. If acceptable, we’ll prepare an updated SOW and a DocuSign packet.

Action items: 
- Emily / SolaceOps: send the signed PO referencing Redwood Inference (as above) and confirm whether you want Redwood to sign the DocuSign SOW or sign locally and return a PDF.
- Vanessa: finance will validate the PO and create the invoice once we have the signed SOW; please expedite on receipt.
- Kimberly: add customer KMS ARN steps to the activation packet and confirm any timeline delta.
- Lauren: prepare SOW v1.3 with 12-month term + standard marketplace clauses; redline to be returned by EOD Wed (7/16).

Looping the AWS partner to help reconcile marketplace listing steps — @aws-mp-partner, can you confirm whether GovCloud listings need any additional partner verification beyond the normal Partner Central activation?

Thanks — feel free to propose a 20-minute slot tomorrow for a quick procurement sync if that helps.

Sean

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Emily Carter <emily@solaceops.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SolaceOps: Onramp checklist for AWS Marketplace PO (GovCloud scope)

Hi all — I reviewed SOW v1.2 and drafted SOW v1.3 with the 12-month term and the usual marketplace addendum. Key points: 

- Term updated to 12 months, auto-renews unless terminated with 60 days’ notice.
- GovCloud KMS: clause added that Redwood will integrate customer-supplied KMS within GovCloud region; customer is responsible for providing key ARN and granting necessary IAM permissions.
- Marketplace billing: clarified that billing will flow via AWS Marketplace and Redwood will accept PO + Marketplace listing confirmation as evidence to trigger activation.
- No change to pricing in SOW; any discount needs separate approval (if SolaceOps wants to request a one-time credit, ping me).

Emily — I’ll upload the redline and final DocuSign packet to this thread. Please confirm whether you want us to send DocuSign or if you prefer to sign and return a PDF PO + SOW.

Next steps checklist (my view):
1) SolaceOps: confirm payee fields on PO and return signed PO (procurements@redwoodinference.com) — attach W9 if not already provided.
2) Redwood: finalize SOW v1.3 and send DocuSign (Lauren).
3) SolaceOps: confirm intent to use customer-managed KMS and provide ARN — Kimberly to validate steps.
4) AWS MP partner: confirm any GovCloud listing verification items.

I’ll target sending DocuSign within 2 business hours.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Dir, Legal Ops — Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
